Since 2007

About Al Qaryan Industries

We are a Karachi-based recycling and trading company. We buy plastic scrap, turn it into clean regrind and pellets, manufacture PVC pipes, and supply manufacturers across Pakistan.

Who we are

Al Qaryan Industries LLC was established in 2007 in Karachi, Pakistan. For almost two decades we have done one thing consistently: take plastic that would otherwise be waste, process it to a standard a manufacturer can rely on, and deliver it on time.

We are not a broker. Our team runs the shredder, the washing line, the pelletiser and two PVC pipe extrusion lines at our Shershah Industrial Area facility, and we handle the material from purchase through processing to delivery.

How we work

  • Buy with discipline. We source scrap from Japan, the USA, Canada, Malaysia, the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Indonesia, and from reliable local suppliers. Material is inspected before it is bought, not after.
  • Process to spec. Shredding, washing, drying and pelletising to the form the customer's machine needs.
  • Document everything. Each lot is tested for the parameters that matter to the application and shipped with the paperwork the buyer asks for.
  • Sell locally, support locally. Our customers are Pakistani pipe makers, film producers, injection moulders and compounders.

Capacity at a glance

Processing capacity500 tons per month
Recycling equipmentShredder, washing line, pelletiser
Pipe production2 PVC pipe extrusion lines
LocationShershah Industrial Area, Karachi, Pakistan
Established2007
CertificationsISO 9001, ISO 14001, REACH compliance, SGS inspection reports
RegistrationsNTN / GST registered, chamber of commerce member

What we stand for

Recycling only works when the output is genuinely usable. That is the standard we hold ourselves to: material that runs in a customer's machine without surprises, and a price that reflects the real cost of doing it properly. Our ISO 14001 system keeps the environmental side honest; our ISO 9001 system keeps the quality side consistent.

Service

Plastic recycling in Karachi

We take plastic scrap and return it to manufacturers as clean, consistent regrind and pellets — 500 tons a month through shredding, washing and pelletising.

What happens to the material

  1. Purchase and inspection. Scrap is inspected before purchase: polymer type, contamination, moisture, colour mix. Material that will not process well is refused rather than blended in.
  2. Sorting. Manual and mechanical separation by polymer and colour, with metal and foreign matter removed.
  3. Shredding. Size reduction to a consistent flake for washing and feeding.
  4. Washing and drying. Washing removes dirt, labels and residues; drying brings moisture down before melting.
  5. Pelletising. Flake is melted and cut into pellets, or supplied as washed flake/regrind when the customer's process prefers that form.
  6. Testing and dispatch. Batch tested for the parameters the application needs, packed and delivered with documentation.

Polymers we process

HDPE LDPE PP PET PVC ABS & PS

Why imported feedstock matters

A recycling line is only as good as its input. Much of our raw material comes from Japan, the USA, Canada, Malaysia, the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Indonesia, where collection and sorting are established. That gives a cleaner, more predictable feedstock than mixed local scrap — and the difference shows up in the regrind your machine receives.

Quality and environment

Our processes run under ISO 9001 and ISO 14001, with REACH compliance for customers who need it and SGS inspection available on request. See our certifications.

Manufactured in-house

PVC pipe manufacturing

PVC and UPVC pipes produced on our own two extrusion lines at Shershah Industrial Area, Karachi — controlled from compound to finished length.

What we manufacture

Our extrusion lines produce PVC pipe for plumbing, drainage and irrigation use, in the diameters and pressure classes agreed with the customer. Because the compound comes through our own recycling operation, we control what goes into the pipe rather than buying finished stock and relabelling it.

If you need a size or fitting we do not extrude ourselves, we supply it through our pipe supply service from vetted mills — and we tell you clearly which is which.

Production control

  • Compound control. Recycled PVC is screened and blended to a consistent formulation before extrusion.
  • Two lines. Capacity to run standard sizes continuously while a second line covers a different diameter or a custom order.
  • Dimensional checks. Wall thickness, outer diameter and length checked through the run, not only at the end.
  • Traceable batches. Orders are recorded against the batch they came from.

For suppliers

We buy plastic scrap

If you collect, sort or trade plastic scrap, we are a buyer with our own processing plant — 500 tons a month of real capacity, not a speculator's phone number.

Send photos on WhatsApp Call +92 333 201 0506

What we buy

  • HDPE — bottles, crates, caps, pipe scrap
  • LDPE — film, shrink wrap, bags, liner scrap
  • PP — woven sacks, containers, caps, crates
  • PET — bottles, preforms, flake
  • PVC — rigid pipe, profile and window scrap
  • ABS / PS — electronics and appliance housings

Where we buy from

Pakistan, and internationally from the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the USA, Canada, Malaysia, Japan and Indonesia. Whether you have a single truckload locally or a container abroad, the conversation starts the same way: tell us the material and send photographs.

How the purchase works

  1. Tell us what you have. Polymer, form (bale, loose, film, regrind), approximate quantity, colour mix and where it is.
  2. Send photographs. Clear photos of the material and its packing avoid most misunderstandings.
  3. We inspect. Sample or inspection before we commit — for container lots this happens before shipment.
  4. We agree terms. Price, quantity, packing, delivery or shipment terms, and documentation.
  5. Collection or delivery. We arrange movement to our Shershah Industrial Area facility.

What helps us price your material correctly

Polymer mixSingle polymer or mixed — mixed is bought, but priced differently
ContaminationMetal, dirt, moisture, labels, other plastics
FormBaled, loose, film, flakes, regrind
ColourSingle colour or mixed
QuantityTruckload or container lot
LocationCity, or port of loading for imports

Why sell to a plant rather than a broker

We are the end user of the material, not a middleman looking for a margin. That means fewer surprises on quality claims, a straight answer on price, and a buyer who will still be there next month.

Questions sellers ask

Do you buy mixed plastic?

Yes, but mixed material is priced according to how much of it we can actually recover. Single-polymer loads are worth more, and we will tell you why the price differs rather than just quoting a number.

Do you arrange transport?

For local purchases we can arrange movement to the plant. For imports, terms are agreed before shipment.

What documents do you need for an import lot?

Quality

Quality and certifications

Documented quality is the difference between recycled material that works and material that wastes a production shift.

Our standards

ISO 9001Quality management system — how we control and record what we produce
ISO 14001Environmental management system — how we control the environmental side of processing
REACHCompliance for customers who need it in their own supply chain
SGS inspectionThird-party inspection reports available on request
RegistrationsNTN / GST registered · member of the chamber of commerce

Certificate numbers and issuing bodies are provided with quotations and on request, so a buyer's compliance team can verify them directly.

What we test, and why

  • Moisture. Wet material degrades in the melt and shows up as defects in the finished product.
  • Contamination. Metal, dirt, label and other-polymer content — the single biggest cause of rejections in recycled material.
  • Polymer separation. PVC must not enter polyolefin streams, and vice versa.
  • Colour consistency. Stated per lot, so a buyer knows what will arrive before it arrives.
  • Form and bulk density. Because a machine feeds on a screw, not on a specification sheet.

Documentation you receive

A batch test report with the lot. SGS inspection on request. Certificate copies for your compliance file. If your process needs a specific parameter recorded, tell us and we will test it rather than assume.

Questions buyers ask

Can you send certificates before we order?

Yes — certificate numbers and copies are provided during quotation, so you can verify them.

Do you provide third-party inspection?

SGS inspection is available on request, and is our normal practice for container lots.

What happens if a lot does not meet the agreed specification?

It is discussed against the batch report we both hold. That is precisely why the specification is agreed in writing before production rather than after delivery.

Sustainability

Sustainability without greenwash

We have kept plastic in the value chain since 2007. Here is what that means in practice — and where we are honest about the limits.

What we actually do

  • Recover material instead of discarding it. 500 tons a month of plastic scrap is processed into material manufacturers can use again, replacing virgin polymer in real products.
  • Run an environmental management system. Our ISO 14001 system covers how waste, water, energy and emissions are controlled on site — audited, not asserted.
  • Reject bad input rather than hide it. Contaminated loads are refused or downgraded instead of being blended into a lot that fails downstream. That protects the customer's process and keeps recycled material credible.
  • Keep processing local. Recycling happens in Karachi and serves Pakistani manufacturers, which keeps the transport footprint of the finished material low.

Where we are honest

Recycling is not automatically good. Washing consumes water, melting consumes energy, and badly sorted material becomes waste again at the customer's plant. Our position is straightforward: do the steps properly, document what was done, and do not claim more than the process delivers.

Circularity in practice

We buy scrap from suppliers in Pakistan, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the USA, Canada, Malaysia, Japan and Indonesia; we process it at one site in Karachi; we sell the output to Pakistani manufacturers; and when their offcuts and rejects come back, we process those again. That loop — not a slogan — is the business.

Certifications that support the claim

ISO 14001 for environmental management, ISO 9001 for quality management, REACH compliance, and SGS inspection on request. See certifications.
